subject: Kickoff: BiGG - synthetic sparse graphs for the index teams
body:
Hi all,

Kicking off the BiGG workstream. Our open-source BiGG model generates sparse graphs autoregressively at scales earlier deep generative models couldn't touch, and the extension work added fully autoregressive generation of node/edge features. The product need: the retrieval-index team wants realistic-but-synthetic graph workloads for capacity testing and benchmarking, because production graph snapshots are locked behind privacy review every single time.

Scope: reproduce the released benchmarks (including the GRAN and G2SAT comparisons), then train on sanitized production graph statistics and validate that generated graphs match degree distribution, clustering, and component-size profiles within agreed tolerances.

Milestones: repro + CUDA build sorted by mid-March; feature-generation extension validated in April; index-team integration in May, wrapping by 5/25.

Alina - staffing over to you.

Anders
